proposed_architecture_for_migration_stud: Global account cap 8, retaining the current two-crypto maximum and all existing gross, cash, sleeve, per-name, eligibility, order, ownership, and safety controls
basis: With two crypto slots, six leaves four equity names and at most 0.40 equity target against a configured 0.55 equity sleeve.
Eight is the smallest global cap that can express six equities at the 0.10 per-name ceiling plus two crypto names, subject to strategy sizing and other gates.
No source-derived broker rule, minimum position-weight rule, or operational threshold uniquely establishes six.
The existing six-equity 5+1 research contract is conditional and does not include two simultaneous crypto slot claims.
decision_scope: Freeze a separate architecture migration study; no production adoption or performance claim
